status: FIT-TEST PROTOTYPE; not proven motor-compatible or ready for powered operation

parts.name: BenchPlate
parts.label: 01 | bench plate
parts.explanation: Separate bench plate with four 3.5 mm holes. Clamp securely for manual and low-power fit testing; no load rating is claimed.

parts.name: FingerRootClevis
parts.label: 02 | root clevis and guide
parts.explanation: 5.2 mm moving tongue fits a 6.0 mm clevis gap (0.4 mm nominal per side). Real 2.3 mm M2 pin bores, 1.4 mm flexor guide and rear stop tabs. Printed fit and actual stop angle require hand testing.

parts.name: ProximalPhalanx
parts.label: Finger | proximal phalanx
parts.explanation: 40 mm nominal joint spacing/tip length. 2.3 mm transverse M2 pin bore; 1.4 mm flexor channel at x=3 mm; 1.6 mm dorsal elastic anchor. Clevis stop tabs limit hyperextension after fit testing.

parts.name: ProximalReferencePin
parts.label: Hardware | M2 pin at proximal joint
parts.explanation: Unprinted M2 smooth-shank pin or screw reference. Select length and retain both ends without squeezing the hinge; do not use printed pins.

parts.name: MiddlePhalanx
parts.label: Finger | middle phalanx
parts.explanation: 24 mm nominal joint spacing/tip length. 2.3 mm transverse M2 pin bore; 1.4 mm flexor channel at x=3 mm; 1.6 mm dorsal elastic anchor. Clevis stop tabs limit hyperextension after fit testing.

parts.name: MiddleReferencePin
parts.label: Hardware | M2 pin at middle joint
parts.explanation: Unprinted M2 smooth-shank pin or screw reference. Select length and retain both ends without squeezing the hinge; do not use printed pins.

parts.name: DistalPhalanx
parts.label: Finger | distal phalanx
parts.explanation: 18 mm nominal joint spacing/tip length. 2.3 mm transverse M2 pin bore; 1.4 mm flexor channel at x=3 mm; 1.6 mm dorsal elastic anchor. Clevis stop tabs limit hyperextension after fit testing.

parts.name: DistalReferencePin
parts.label: Hardware | M2 pin at distal joint
parts.explanation: Unprinted M2 smooth-shank pin or screw reference. Select length and retain both ends without squeezing the hinge; do not use printed pins.

parts.name: GenericServoCradle
parts.label: 03 | generic slotted servo cradle
parts.explanation: Generic side-mounted cradle with 42 mm clear body length and adjustable strap/bolt slots. Hitec D645MW official body envelope is 40.8 x 20.0 x 37.8 mm; flange span and output offset are NOT modeled as a verified fit. Measure the actual servo/horn before printing or drilling.

parts.name: ServoEnvelope
parts.label: Reference | D645MW body envelope
parts.explanation: Unprinted reference envelope from official Hitec drawing: 40.8 x 20.0 x 37.8 mm, shown on its side. Output/horn position here is illustrative, not verified.

parts.name: HornMountedDrum
parts.label: 04 | 7 mm-radius tendon drum
parts.explanation: 7 mm effective winding radius, 9 mm flanges, center clearance and two 2.3 mm generic horn fixing holes on 10 mm spacing. This is NOT a printed 25T spline. Drill/match the purchased horn and verify fastener clearance before assembly.

parts.name: RedirectPulley
parts.label: 05 | flexor redirect pulley
parts.explanation: Small unpowered redirect pulley with 2.3 mm bore. The flexor passes from the vertical x=3 mm finger channel around this pulley toward the drum. A smooth bushing/bearing may be required after fit testing.

parts.name: RedirectAxle
parts.label: Hardware | redirect axle
parts.explanation: Unprinted M2 smooth-shank axle reference. Add retained supports/washer stack after a dry-fit check.

parts.explanation: Illustrative 0.5–0.8 mm cord route; actual joint wrap and knot position must be fitted by hand.
